_comment: Throw Bomb (docs/plan-prototype-projectile.md D5, P1): the TIMED half of the D5 pair, ThrowMine's numbers except for the two that decide everything (TTL, and since 2026-08-19 the reach: the mine was pulled in to 1 unit as a PLACED thing, this stays at 3.0 because a bomb is lobbed - see throw-mine.json). ttlTicks 46 = armTicks 45 + 1, which buys exactly ONE fire opportunity: the burst comes ready at the SkillSystem pass (priority -65) of tick 45, and the TTL removes the bomb at the MobSystem pass (priority 20) of tick 46, which runs EARLIER in that tick than the skill pass would have. So it bangs once at the delay if anything is standing there, and otherwise expires having done nothing. ⭐ That arithmetic is a claim about system priority order, not about arithmetic, which is why it is the first thing the sys tests pin (TestProjectile_TimedFiresAtItsOneOpportunity / _TimedDespawnsWithoutFiringWhenEmpty). Change either priority and this file's ttlTicks becomes silently wrong. ⚑ ACCEPTED COARSENESS the PO session judges (§10 item 4): an empty timed bang is INVISIBLE - a burst that reaches nobody applies nothing and shows nothing - so a whiffed bomb reads as the thing simply vanishing. Burst VFX for whiffs would be new client work, deliberately not pre-built. Same aim rules, same clamping, same at-your-feet fallback as ThrowMine (D3). CHEAT-ONLY: `SKILL ThrowBomb`, no unlock source, for the mine's reason. cast 0 / maxLevel 1, and ThrowMine's cost verbatim (see that file: NovaBurst's two costs totalled onto the one projectile effect). ALL VALUES [PLACEHOLDER].
name: ThrowBomb
